messages:
sam-support: Heads-up: multiple customers reporting 502/504s from hosted inference since ~11:05 PDT. Started as a small blip, now persistent. Error rates up ~12% on /v1/generate.

maria-support: Got a support ticket from Acme — repro steps: single sync request, occasional 502 gateway error, sometimes 504 after 30s. They provided a curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","prompt":"test"}' -v
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (x.x.x.x) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> 
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"upstream gateway error"}
```

charlie-runtime: I'm seeing a correlated spike in memcached read timeouts on prefix cache layer (pfx-cache.us-west2). Metrics: memcached_ops.timeouts +420% over baseline; connection errors up across all nodes in pool. Backpressure on getter threads caused request pipeline to return 502s.

alex-sre: Logs from the gateway show: 
```
ERROR 11:06:22 request_id=abcd upstream error: memcached read timeout (host=pfx-cache-03.us-west2)
WARN 11:06:22 request_id=abcd fallback to origin-db=true
ERROR 11:06:23 request_id=efgh upstream returned 502 after 15 retries
```

ingrid-eng: Any change deployed to prefix key format or client that would explode keyspace? We had that before when an indexing job started writing large nested keys.

charlie-runtime: Quick check: a recent ingestion job (ingest-service v2.9.1) started yesterday at 02:00 UTC that added a new prefix `prompt_v2:` and didn't set a TTL. I see increasing key population for `prompt_v2:*` — >600k new keys in last 24h, lots of hot keys with big values (~48KB). Memcached pool sized for ~5M keys but small connection concurrency per node. Thundering read pattern on a few hot keys seems to be saturating worker threads.

sam-support: Customers mentioning latency before errors — so transient slow gets escalate to 502/504. Any mitigation we can flip now?

alex-sre: Short term mitigation options: 1) Increase memcached connection limits + restart a small subset (rolling) to clear stale conn. 2) Enable cache bypass for tiered traffic: set header X-Bypass-Cache:true for hosted-api to fallback to DB (but increases latency and DB load). 3) Patch getter to use local in-process short-LRU for super-hot keys.

charlie-runtime: I can scope a rolling bump of pool/concurrency and take 2 nodes out for a quick restart. Recommend enabling X-Bypass-Cache for high-failure routes while we stabilize. Will coordinate with SRE.

maria-support: I'll advise impacted customers with a temporary workaround: set retry/backoff and note degraded perf if bypassing cache. Need ETA for stabilization.

sre-bot: Oncall pager duty: @alex-sre has been paged for memcached-us-west2. Incident created INC-2023-8473. Priority: P2 -> raising to P1 if customer impact continues.

alex-sre: Starting roll of pfx-cache-us-west2 nodes: will rotate 4/12 nodes, bump max-conns to 1024, enable tcp_keepalive tweaks. Rolling restart ETA 12m. Also toggling treatment rule to set X-Bypass-Cache for any requests where cache latency > 250ms.

ingrid-eng: Repro notes: sending parallel 200 reqs with a hot key reproduces 502s locally when memcached latency >200ms. Script: 
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","prompt":"hotkey-test"}' & done; wait
```

charlie-runtime: After first rotations, memcached timeouts dropped ~60%, 502 rate down to baseline. Monitoring for recurrence. Will follow up with a postmortem and recommend TTLs for prompt_v2 keys and a limiter on key size + guardrails in ingest.

sam-support: Thanks — I'll update tickets and let customers know there's a mitigation in prod and follow-up change.

maria-support: Can we get an RFC for prefix cache lifecycle policy? We need ops-safe defaults for TTL, key size, and backpressure.

charlie-runtime: Agreed — I'll draft RFC and include detection rules (hot-key alerts, key churn > X, avg memcached latency). Posting follow-up in #eng-runtime once ready.

sam-support: Closing loop: customers updated, incident remains open while monitoring. Will add notes to each support ticket. :white_check_mark:
